definitions.explanation: The ability to perceive through physical contact, including pressure, texture, and temperature.
The sensory appendages on insects and crustaceans used to feel their environment.

examples.japanese: {目|め}を{閉|と}じて{触覚|しょっかく}だけで{物|もの}を{当|あ}てる。
examples.english: Guess objects using only your sense of touch with your eyes closed.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんは{触覚|しょっかく}が{敏感|びんかん}だ。
examples.english: Babies have a sensitive sense of touch.

examples.japanese: {昆虫|こんちゅう}は{触覚|しょっかく}で{周囲|しゅうい}の{情報|じょうほう}を{得|え}る。
examples.english: Insects gather information about their surroundings through their antennae.

notes:
{触覚|しょっかく} has two meanings:

1. Sense of touch (one of the five senses)
2. Antenna/feelers (on insects)

The five senses ({五感|ごかん}):
- {視覚|しかく} (sight)
- {聴覚|ちょうかく} (hearing)
- {嗅覚|きゅうかく} (smell)
- {味覚|みかく} (taste)
- {触覚|しょっかく} (touch)

Common expressions:
- {触覚|しょっかく}が{鋭|するど}い (to have a keen sense of touch)
- {触覚|しょっかく}を{伸|の}ばす (to extend one's antennae - also figuratively: to seek information)

Note:
For insects, {触覚|しょっかく} refers to the antennae. Alternative words for insect antennae include {触角|しょっかく} (same pronunciation, different kanji) and アンテナ.
